title: Machined Aluminum Spacer Block (AP214)
description: ISO 10303-21 STEP AP214 geometric definition of a 50x40x20 mm machined 6061-T6 aluminum spacer block with datum coordinate frame.

title: ISO Metric Flanged Shaft Coupling
description: STEP AP214 cylindrical shaft coupling featuring concentric bore, outer flange cylinder, and four-bolt mounting circle geometry.

title: Countersunk L-Bracket with Fillet Geometry
description: STEP AP242 sheet-metal structural L-bracket combining planar web faces, cylindrical inner bend fillet, and conical countersunk mounting holes.

title: Three-Part Robotic Wrist Sub-Assembly (AP242)
description: Hierarchical STEP AP242 product structure assembling a wrist housing, harmonic-drive flange, and end-effector tool plate via NEXT_ASSEMBLY_USAGE_OCCURRENCE.

title: Precision Drone Motor Mount MBD + QIF Metrology
description: Multi-file Model-Based Definition package pairing a STEP AP242 UAV brushless motor mount assembly with its companion QIF 3.0 GD&T CMM inspection plan.
